summary: Inserts one column before the data, on a sheet or at a range.
description: `prependColumns` with a single column: room is made first, so nothing already there is overwritten. A sheet gets the column at its start; a range gets it immediately before its first column, with the values written on the range's rows.
The values go in as a flat array of cells, top to bottom. Omit them and an empty column is inserted.
A cell whose text starts with `=` is written as a formula, not as text — the same rule the editor follows.

params.target: The sheet to insert into, or the range to insert at.
params.values: The cells of the single column, top to bottom. Omit for an empty column.
params.options: `afterFrozenColumns` inserts after the frozen columns instead of at the very start. A range decides the position itself, so the option does nothing there.

returns: the sheet, so calls can be chained.

throws.IllegalArgumentException: the values are given but are not a non-empty flat array.
throws.InvalidSheetException: the first argument is neither a sheet nor a range.

examples.title: Inserting at the start of a sheet
